text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PD-ALERT-9012 fired for service `metering-ingest` - threshold: consumer lag > 5m and token_count_delta < -5% over 10m. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-ALERT-9012

oncall_jess: ack'd. I'm on it. paging SRE.

alex_chen: oncall_jess ping — any estimated customer impact?

oncall_jess: initial checks: consumer group offsets stalled on kafka-pipeline-2, offsets not progressing for topic metering-raw. No obvious OOMs on pods. CPU ok. attaching logs:
```
consumer[metering-ingest] WARN RebalanceInProgress
Processed 0 messages in last 60s, lag=430k
```

maria_garcia: I'll take repro/consumer-side. Running `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=metering-ingest -o wide` now.

incident-bot: Escalation policy: not acknowledged by owner group within 5m -> paging on-call SRE. Escalation step 2 fired.

ben_walsh: trending: token count delta shows -6% for invoice window for last 30m. Might affect this morning's billed usage snapshot.

tara_sales: heads up — we have 3 enterprise customers with invoices queued. Billing PM @billing-pm notified.

billing-pm: on it. If token counts are underreported we may need to delay invoice run. What's the scope?

sam_irving: scope: ~380k messages unprocessed, correlates to ~1.1M tokens. Affects any customers with high-throughput burst between 07:00-07:45 UTC.

oncall_jess: mitigation step 1: restart one consumer pod to trigger rebalance and drain stuck partitions. Doing rolling restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/metering-ingest -n prod --field-selector metadata.name=metering-ingest` (watching)

alex_chen: while restarting, spin up temporary consumer in staging w/ same config to validate no schema regressions — low risk.

oncall_jess: pod restarted, offsets moved for 4 partitions. lag decreasing. still holding on some partitions where demux consumer shows `ERR_FETCH_TIMEOUT`.

maria_garcia: increased consumer parallelism by 2 replicas. Monitoring lag trend.

ben_walsh: token counts recomputing in metric-store shows partial recovery: delta -1.2% now vs -6% earlier. Good signal.

billing-pm: ok to proceed with invoice run in 30m if metrics stable, else we'll delay and notify customers. Please add a short incident update to the status page.

oncall_jess: will create incident timeline and a short status update: "Investigation: metering ingest consumer lag caused temporary undercount; rolling restart and scale mitigated. Monitoring for recovery." :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident acknowledged by oncall_jess at 1802345685. PagerDuty incident PD-ALERT-9012 assigned to metering-ingest oncall.

sam_irving: handoff: I'm taking follow-up to ensure backfill completes and metrics regressions are cleared. tagging @maria_garcia for backfill steps.

maria_garcia: noted. Plan: trigger backfill job `metering-backfill --from 2026-03-14T07:00Z --to 2026-03-14T07:45Z` with concurrency 4, watch for duplicates. Will post completion ETA.

billing-pm: thanks — keep me posted. If backfill shows >0.5% diff vs snapshot we delay invoices and email affected accounts.

oncall_jess: last check: lag trending to zero, consumer error rate normalized. I'll stay on call until backfill done. Last message at 1802346140
